name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
summary: Turns one option on or off, independently of the others.
description: Turn one option on or off, independently of the others. A 16px box on a hairline ring that fills with ink when checked; the box fills first and the check is then drawn from the inline start (the dash of the indeterminate state from its centre); unchecking is a shorter plain fade. The whole row, label included, is the hit area. Behaviour, focus and ARIA come from the Zag checkbox machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte. A visually hidden native checkbox carries focus, Space and the form value.

anatomy.description: The row and its hit area; data-state=checked|unchecked|indeterminate, data-disabled, data-invalid, data-focus-visible. In row layout it composes the shared option row (`lib/option.ts`). Wrapper rule: class and style land on this outermost element (what a caller sizes and places); every other attribute stays on the control.

The 16px box (18px at size md; aria-hidden); same state attributes as the root; carries kbd-instant. Usable outside the label: written by hand in an option row (with this recipe's control and mark classes) it hovers and presses with that row.
Decorative check (data-mark=check) and dash (data-mark=indeterminate); shown through the control's data-state; carries kbd-instant
Native checkbox, visually hidden: focus, Space and the form value

size.description: sm: the 16px box. md: an 18px box, for table rows.

tone.description: Colour of the checked fill: ink, or red / green for a change to remove / add. The mark is white on red and green in both themes.

layout.description: inline: the box with its label, sized to the text. row: fills a 30px option row (`lib/option.ts`: padding, radius, press hover-2) in a list that owns one glide highlight (`glideLayer` of `lib/glide.ts`; glide(list, layer, { rows: "[data-slot=checkbox]", follow: "hover" })); the box is drawn the same.

disabled.description: Reaches the input in every target.

tabIndex.description: tabindex of the input (the focusable part), for a host that runs a roving tab stop over several boxes (diff-table).

keyboard: Tab reaches each checkbox; every box is its own tab stop
notes: Give it a visible label or an aria-label.
Indeterminate is reported as mixed (the native input's indeterminate state).
Several related checkboxes sit in a group with a label (role=group + aria-label, or a fieldset).
To set it from outside, control `checked` (true, false or "indeterminate"): React checked / onCheckedChange, Vue v-model:checked, Svelte bind:checked.

motion: box on: fill and ring colour over duration.fast, ease; it leads

check on: drawn by a clip-path wipe from the inline start, inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0), over duration.base with easing.out-strong, delayed by duration.stagger so the fill leads; no scale, no opacity ramp; the glyph is not mirrored right to left, so neither is the wipe
dash on: the same wipe from its centre, inset(0 50%) to inset(0)
off (and the old mark when check and dash swap): opacity to 0 over duration.fast with easing.out-strong, no wipe, no delay; the box empties over duration.fast; the clip resets after the fade
press (pointer only): the box scales to motion.press-scale-sm over duration.press with easing.out-strong and springs back the same way
keyboard (Space): instant; the control and both marks carry kbd-instant and the mark's delay drops
mount: nothing animates on the first paint, in every target
reduced motion: no wipe; the marks fade over duration.fast both ways; the press stays
size, tone and row layout change no motion: the same fill, wipe, exit and press; in a row the press also darkens the row (hover-2)
